description: `prompt-manager team heartbeat-list <team>` human output currently shows e.g. `last: never` or `last: completed at <timestamp>` — which conflates three distinct lifecycle states: (1) enabled but never fired (first-fire window not yet reached for a newly-enabled team — healthy), (2) enabled with past fires but none recent (possibly dormant or broken), (3) disabled entirely. The JSON output includes `nextExecution`; human view drops it. Prep-agent and operator both need this distinction to decide whether a silent queue is 'quiet' (genuinely no decisions) vs 'dormant' (agent broken and not surfacing) vs 'scheduled-not-yet-fired' (first-day activation, wait). Human output should surface nextExecution and explicitly label the state (e.g., `[enabled/scheduled] next: <timestamp>` vs `[enabled/dormant] last: <timestamp>`). Surfaced 2026-04-23 walk (filed in prior batch as initial note; re-surfaced 2026-04-24 walk) — needs concrete implementation.
name: prompt-manager-heartbeat-list-lifecycle-states
title: Heartbeat-list should distinguish scheduled-never-fired vs dormant vs broken
